This document lists 
the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed every three months as 
indicated by M3 in the above title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Abd Allah Alsayed Mohamed 
Alsyed, accepted by 
general director eng. Al Syed Atiah Abdel Maqsoud, revised by 
EDEPC inspection & quality control eng. Adel Abdel Qader Mohamed Alnagar, approved by 
eng. Awad Soliman: head sector of Talkha PS, and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy: 
EDEPC inspection and quality 
control head sector.

items:
A work permit must be issued, 
the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,

Wear your safety helmet, 
 safety shoes .... etc

The circuit breaker under 
test must be out of service.
Circuit breaker must be isolated & proper earthing at the two sides of CB.
Isolate control circuit (DC voltage)
Change remote/local switch to local position.
Safety helmet & safety shoes.
Portable air blower,
Screw driver, and set of common keys.

Make sure that the supply 
 voltages and currents of low voltage circuits are in accordance with rated values.

Make sure that the 
 hydraulic cubicle is correctly grounded.

Check the oil level in 
 the main tank.

Check the operation of 
 heating system inside the cabinet.

Check the good working of 
 the signaling lamp according to the mimic diagram.

Check the hydraulic 
 component for tightness as follows:
 External 
 leakage:
 - In order to detect any oil leaks, clean the various unions and pipes before 
 proceed with a tightness inspection.
 Internal 
 leakage:
 - Make sure that the rated pressure has been reached, 
 -Cut off the operating mechanism power supply.

Check the reference 
 values of SF6 gas pressure as follows:
 6 bar for 220kv Circuit Breakers 
 7 bar for 66kv Circuit Breakers 
 4.2 bar for other compartment

text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists 
the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed every three months as 
indicated by M3 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Abd Allah Alsayed Mohamed 
Alsyed, accepted by 
general director eng. Al Syed Atiah Abdel Maqsoud, revised by 
EDEPC inspection & quality control eng. Adel Abdel Qader Mohamed Alnagar, approved by 
eng. Awad Soliman: head sector of Talkha PS, and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy: 
EDEPC inspection and quality 
control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, 
the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,
Wear your safety helmet, 
 safety shoes .... etc
The circuit breaker under 
test must be out of service.
Circuit breaker must be isolated & proper earthing at the two sides of CB.
Isolate control circuit (DC voltage)
Change remote/local switch to local position.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet & safety shoes.
Portable air blower,
Screw driver, and set of common keys.
Work to be Carried Out
Make sure that the supply 
 voltages and currents of low voltage circuits are in accordance with rated values.
Make sure that the 
 hydraulic cubicle is correctly grounded.
Check the oil level in 
 the main tank.
Check the operation of 
 heating system inside the cabinet.
Check the good working of 
 the signaling lamp according to the mimic diagram.
Check the hydraulic 
 component for tightness as follows:
 External 
 leakage:
 - In order to detect any oil leaks, clean the various unions and pipes before 
 proceed with a tightness inspection.
 Internal 
 leakage:
 - Make sure that the rated pressure has been reached, 
 -Cut off the operating mechanism power supply.
Check the reference 
 values of SF6 gas pressure as follows:
 6 bar for 220kv Circuit Breakers 
 7 bar for 66kv Circuit Breakers 
 4.2 bar for other compartment

sections_ar.text: تسرد هذه الوثيقة فحص المعدات I1، الذي يجب تنفيذه كل ثلاثة أشهر كما هو موضح بالرمز M3 في خانة العنوان أعلاه.

أعد المسودة الأولى م. Abd Allah Alsayed Mohamed Alsyed، وقبلها المدير العام م. Al Syed Atiah Abdel Maqsoud، وراجعها م. Adel Abdel Qader Mohamed Alnagar، مهندس التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة في EDEPC، واعتمدها م. Awad Soliman، رئيس قطاع محطة كهرباء طلخا، ووثقها م. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy، رئيس قطاع التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة في EDEPC.

items: يجب إصدار أمر شغل، ويجب أن يحمل طاقم الصيانة المؤهل فئة السلامة المناسبة،
ارتدِ خوذة السلامة وحذاء السلامة .... إلخ.
يجب أن يكون قاطع الدائرة قيد الاختبار خارج الخدمة.
يجب عزل قاطع الدائرة والتأريض السليم على جانبي القاطع.
افصل دائرة التحكم (جهد التيار المستمر).
حوّل مفتاح التحكم عن بُعد/المحلي إلى الوضع المحلي.
خوذة السلامة وحذاء السلامة.
منفاخ هواء محمول،
مفك وطقم مفاتيح عادية.
تأكد من أن جهود وتيارات تغذية دوائر الجهد المنخفض مطابقة للقيم المقننة.
تأكد من تأريض الخزانة الهيدروليكية بشكل صحيح.
افحص مستوى الزيت في الخزان الرئيسي.
افحص عمل نظام التدفئة داخل الخزانة.
افحص سلامة عمل لمبة الإشارة وفقًا للمخطط المحاكي.

افحص إحكام المكونات الهيدروليكية كما يلي: التسرب الخارجي: - للكشف عن أي تسرب زيت، نظف الوصلات والأنابيب المختلفة قبل البدء في فحص الإحكام. التسرب الداخلي: - تأكد من الوصول إلى الضغط المقنن، - افصل مصدر تغذية آلية التشغيل.
افحص القيم المرجعية لضغط غاز SF6 كما يلي: 6 بار لقواطع دائرة 220 ك.ف، 7 بار لقواطع دائرة 66 ك.ف، 4.2 بار للحجيرات الأخرى.
